lines.text: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah at twenty, walked in the ways of Israel's kings, and sacrificed his son.
Rezin king of Aram and Pekah king of Israel besieged Ahaz, and Rezin recovered Elath for Aram.
Ahaz sent silver and gold from the temple to the king of Assyria, who captured Damascus and took its people to Haran.
Ahaz sent Uriah the priest plans of the Damascus altar, and Uriah finished building it after Ahaz returned.
Ahaz was buried with his fathers in the City of David, and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
